controller_6m.notes: Quote verbatim on p262. Rule 10.07 + Chapter 4.13 of the Guide undertaking by the Single Largest Shareholder Group (issuer has no 'Controlling Shareholders' as such): 'at any time in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of its/his shareholding is made in this Prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date' - inclusive end -> first free 2026-11-28, last restricted 2026-11-27. Confirmed the SE undertaking on p262 contains NO second six-month clause (p263 starts the underwriting-agreement undertakings).

controller_12m.notes: Quote verbatim on p264. This is the 12-month undertaking under the Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement: 'at any time during the 12 months from the Listing Date' - duration wording -> frees ON the 12-month anniversary 2027-05-27, last restricted 2027-05-26 (python-verified). Paragraph (b) (p264) confirmed to be only an orderly-market obligation: 'until the expiry of the 12 months from the Listing Date ... take all reasonable steps to ensure that such a disposal will not create a disorderly or false market'. Recording it in the 12m slot with exists=true and a transparent basis is appropriate since no Rule 10.07(1)(b) clause exists.
